# Baseline Unique Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement the baseline `unique()` operation for supported integer and real element types, returning an owned 1D tensor with unspecified result order.

**Architecture:** `unique.rs` owns both the sealed `UniqueElement` trait and the `TensorBase::unique()` inherent method. The baseline implementation uses logical iteration and linear-scan deduplication, flattens any input rank to a logical 1D sequence, and returns an owned contiguous `Tensor<A, Ix1>`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `TensorBase`, `Tensor<A, Ix1>`, `Element`

**Design Docs:** `design/14-set.md` §5.1, §6.1, §6.4, §8.2; `design/01-architecture.md` §1.5, §2.1; `design/00-coding.md` §2.3, §2.5, §2.9

**Prerequisites:** W18T1 and W11T2 must be complete.

use xenon::tensor::Tensor;

#[test]
fn test_unique_basic_i32() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([6], vec![3_i32, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2]).unwrap();
    let out = tensor.unique();
    assert_eq!(out.len(), 3);
}

#[test]
fn test_unique_empty() {
    let tensor = Tensor::from_shape_vec([0], Vec::<i32>::new()).unwrap();
    let out = tensor.unique();
    assert_eq!(out.len(), 0);

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the complete baseline unique implementation**

Replace `src/set/unique.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::dimension::{Dimension, Ix1};
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::tensor::{Tensor, TensorBase};
use crate::storage::Storage;

pub trait UniqueElement: private::Sealed + Element {
    fn unique_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}

mod private {
    pub trait Sealed {}
}

impl private::Sealed for i32 {}
impl private::Sealed for i64 {}
impl private::Sealed for f32 {}
impl private::Sealed for f64 {}

impl UniqueElement for i32 {
    fn unique_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self == other }
}

impl UniqueElement for i64 {
    fn unique_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self == other }
}

impl UniqueElement for f32 {
    fn unique_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self == other }
}

impl UniqueElement for f64 {
    fn unique_eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self == other }
}

impl<S, D, A> TensorBase<S, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension,
    A: UniqueElement + Copy,
{
    pub fn unique(&self) -> Tensor<A, Ix1> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for &value in self.iter() {
            if !out.iter().any(|existing| existing.unique_eq(&value)) {
                out.push(value);
            }
        }
        unsafe { Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(out, Ix1(out.len())) }
    }
}
```
